HARNESS DETAIL: pre-terminated 12-pin GT150 to 8HP TCU (CAN H/L + main 12V + wakeup + GND) + BMW F-series 10-pin CAN shifter connector. Running DCTShifter in SEQ mode: BMW 10-pin end capped unused. CRITICAL: TCU main 12V must be live 10-15s before key-on wakeup signal or TCU partially fails to init — use power-hold relay, not both wires on same switched fuse.
